title: Executive Order No. 119, s. 2020
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 119

ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATIVE
CENTER IN NEW CLARK CITY, CAPAS, TARLAC, PROVIDING
FOR AN INTEGRATED GOVERNMENT CENTER OUTSIDE THE
NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION IN CASE OF DISASTER, AND
DIRECTING THE WHOLE-OF-GOVERNMENT TO ESTABLISH
SATELLITE OFFICES THEREIN

WHEREAS, the government reiterates its commitment to strengthen the
country’s resilience against earthquakes, floods and other natural disasters for the
purpose of ensuring public safety, government and business continuity, and national
security;

WHEREAS, the coastal communities in the Philippines, particularly those in the
National Capital Region (NCR), are most vulnerable to subsidence, rising sea levels,
and increased risk of floods, resulting from climate change and contributory human
activities;

WHEREAS, the NCR, where the seat of the National Government is presently
located, is also exposed to the threat of a catastrophic earthquake that may be caused
by the movements of the West and East Valley Faults;

WHEREAS, in view of the potential repercussions to the seat of the National
Government from aforesaid threats, pursuant to the strategies under Executive Order
No. 52 (s. 2018), there is an urgent need to establish an integrated government center
outside the NCR, which will serve as a back-up administrative hub and which may be
utilized as disaster recovery center, to ensure continuity of government services, as
well as facilitate collaboration and coordination between and among government
agencies,

WHEREAS, the establishment of a back-up government center outside the
NCR supports the policy of addressing longstanding issues on the lack of sustainable
employment opportunities in the countryside, unbalanced regional development, and
unequal distribution of wealth;

WHEREAS, the development of integrated government centers is aligned with
the Philippine Development Plan 2017-2022, which espouses strategies towards the
decongestion of the NCR, and is in accordance with AmBisyon Natin 2040, which
makes countryside development as one of its priority sectors;
 
WHEREAS, the establishment of integrated government centers fosters ease
of doing business, provides equal access to efficient and effective delivery of public
services, and serves as a catalyst for the creation of new economic opportunities
outside the NCR, through the development of new townships and commercial
business districts; and

WHEREAS, Section 17, Article Vil of the 1987 Constitution grants the President
control of all the executive departments, bureaus and offices;

NOW, THEREFORE, I, RODRIGO ROA DUTERTE, President of the Republic
of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing
laws, do hereby order:

SECTION 1. Establishment of a National Government Administrative Center
(NGAC) in New Clark City. An NGAC is hereby established in New Clark City, Capas,
Tarlac, to serve as an integrated government center outside the NCR, and, in case of
disaster, a recovery center and back-up administrative hub.

All departments, bureaus, offices and agencies under the Executive Branch,
are hereby directed to establish satellite or field offices at the NGAC in New Clark City,
in accordance with existing laws, rules and regulations. For this purpose, all concerned
offices shall formulate and adopt appropriate business continuity and financial plans,
including the operationalization of their respective back-up offices at the NGAC, in
case of a calamity capable of paralyzing government operations in the NCR.

To the extent consistent with their mandates and purposes, government-owned
or -controlled corporations (GOCCs) are encouraged to locate satellite or field offices
at the NGAC in New Clark City. In the same manner, the Legislative and Judicial
Branches of Government, and independent constitutional bodies, are encouraged to
establish appropriate offices thereat.

The foregoing shall be without prejudice to national government departments,
bureaus, offices and agencies, including GOCCs, transferring their respective Central
Offices at the NGAC in New Clark City, especially if their functions do not require their
main offices to be in the NCR.

SECTION 2. Phases and Clusters for the Establishment of Satellite and Field
Offices. The establishment of satellite or field offices shall be done in phases and
clusters to be determined by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management
Council, in coordination with the concerned offices.

The departments or agencies which have an existing regional, field or satellite
office within the vicinity of or proximate to the New Clark City may transfer their
regional office at the NGAC established herein, subject to existing laws, rules and
regulations.

SECTION 3. Manpower Requirements. The manpower requirements for such
offices shall not be a basis for the creation of unnecessary redundant positions, and
shall be limited to those which are essential to the implementation of their respective
disaster contingency plans, and when warranted, the delivery of public services at the
NGAC.
 
SECTION 4. Assistance for the Establishment of Offices at the NGAC. The
Bases Conversion and Development Authority shall assist concerned government
agencies in securing advantageous, cost-efficient and flexible logistical and financial

arrangements relative to the establishment of their respective satellite or field offices
at the NGAC.

SECTION 5. Funding. The budgetary requirements for the implementation of
this Order shall be sourced from available funds of the concerned agencies and
offices, and when appropriate and necessary, such other funding sources as the
Department of Budget and Management may identify, subject to existing policies,
budgeting, accounting and auditing laws, rules and regulations.

SECTION 6. Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

SECTION 7. Separability. In the event that any provision or portion of this Order
is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain
in force and effect.

SECTION 8. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately after its
publication in the Official Gazette or a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE in the City of Manila, this 17th dayof November , in the year of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty.
